name: Jean-Luc Dubois
bio:
Jean-Luc's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. A former military police officer with experience in high-threat environments, he transitioned to securing race events after a chance encounter with a team owner seeking a meticulous and adaptable security lead. Jean-Luc is not your typical security chief; his approach blends tactical expertise with a surprisingly keen understanding of the motorsport environment. He believes in proactive security, anticipating potential threats before they materialize, and fostering a collaborative relationship with all team members.

His management style is characterized by clear communication and a commitment to empowering his team. He's known for his ability to quickly adapt security protocols to changing circumstances, whether it's a last-minute venue change or an unexpected influx of fans. Jean-Luc's eye for detail is legendary; he leaves no stone unturned in his pursuit of a safe and secure environment for everyone involved in the race.

physical.description: Jean-Luc is of average height with a wiry build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on a pre-race espresso, prepared exactly the same way each time.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
